long_biography.plain_text:
Topsail Re was designed around David Johnson’s preference for long-term partnerships with regional insurers and mutuals. He established a Cayman-domiciled, closely held reinsurer with a Greensboro underwriting arm and a deliberately lean decision-making structure, contributing personal capital alongside backing from other investors.

Working with co-founder David Lee, Johnson concentrated Topsail on quota-share and bespoke structures rather than pursuing only large transactions. The company later paired its own balance sheet with selected third-party growth capital while retaining its closely held ownership structure. This relationship-led underwriting carried Topsail from its first renewal season into a substantial independent platform, where Johnson remains chairman and chief executive.
